_readme: Buyer questions in the buyer's own words, for answer-engine coverage (GEO).
WHY THIS EXISTS. Our Schema is already complete — Product, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList,
ItemList, Organization, WebSite and ContactPoint all emit, and llms.txt is generated
from the catalogue. What we cannot show is that any page ANSWERS what a buyer asks.
An assistant summarising 'panic exit device manufacturer China MOQ' quotes whichever
page contains the answer; if no page contains it, more markup changes nothing.
THE PERSONA IS NOT A CONSUMER. The widely circulated version of this exercise uses a
25-year-old shopping for desk organisers. Ours is a hardware importer or a project
buyer building a door schedule: they ask about backset, handing, fire rating, MOQ,
cylinder standard and lead time, and they compare against Assa Abloy, Dorma, Kale and
the cheaper Guangdong factories. Questions here are written in their register —
colloquial where a buyer would be colloquial, technical where they would be technical.
HOW `needs` WORKS. Each question names what would answer it, so coverage can be
measured instead of guessed. scripts/lib/question-coverage.mjs scores this file;
audit-question-coverage.mjs prints the numbers and build-supplier-workbook.mjs turns
the unanswered ones into docs/research/SUPPLIER_WORKBOOK.html, the sheet a human fills
in. Chinese wording for each open question lives in buyer-questions.zh.json.
reports real numbers.
spec  — a spec row on the product records; coverage = share of that category
carrying the label
faq   — a question in content/faq.json; covered only when its answer is non-empty
page  — a route that exists and says something on the subject
gap   — nothing on the site answers this today. These are the deliverable.
Do not invent answers to close a gap. Empty is honest; invented is an incident —
a buyer orders against it. See AGENTS.md, 内容纪律.

universal._note: Asked of every category. A buyer asks these before they ask about product.

questions.q: What is your minimum order quantity?
How long before you can ship after I place the order?
Can I get a sample first? Do I pay for it?
What payment terms do you take — TT, LC, 30% deposit?
Can you put my brand on it instead of HYDE?
Do you actually make these or are you a trading company?
Do you ship to my country?
Can I just buy through Alibaba instead of emailing?
Can you send the drawings with dimensions?
I need test reports for a tender — can you supply them?
Which finishes can I get this in?
What is it actually made of — solid brass or plated zinc?
Where is this meant to be used — commercial, residential, fire door?
How many open/close cycles is it rated for?
How do you pack it, and how many per carton?

needs.why: Packing appears on 6 of 435 records; a buyer needs carton quantity and gross weight to cost freight.

questions.q: What is the HS code for customs?

needs.why: No HS codes anywhere on the site. Every importer needs one to clear goods and to estimate duty.

questions.q: What warranty do you give?

needs.why: No warranty statement on any page. Commonly the second question after price.

questions.q: Can I get spare parts and replacement cylinders later?

needs.why: No spare-parts or after-sales page.

questions.q: How do you compare with Assa Abloy or Dorma on this?

needs.why: No comparison content. Answer engines have nothing to quote when a buyer asks a versus question.

questions.q: How do I install it? Is there a template?
Is this certified to EN 1125?
Can I use it on a fire door?
Does it work on a double door with both leaves?
Push bar or touch bar — what is the difference and which do I need?

needs.why: No explainer page. This is the single most asked comparison in the category.

questions.q: Can it be opened from outside with a key?
Does it come with an alarm?
What width of door does the bar fit?
Is there a version that locks at top and bottom as well?
Will it hold up in a cold room or outdoors?
What is the outside trim made of and can I get it in stainless?
What backset do you have? I need 45 and 60.
What is the centre distance between the handle and the cylinder?
Does it take a euro profile cylinder?
How far does the deadbolt throw?
What door thickness does it suit?
Is it handed, or can it be used left and right?
What size spindle does it take — 8mm square?
Is the forend stainless or plated steel?
Does the strike plate come with it?
Will your case fit a lock body from another brand's faceplate cutout?

needs.why: No interchange or cross-reference table. Replacement buyers ask this first.

questions.q: What is the difference between your heavy duty and light duty range?

needs.why: Sub-categories exist as filters but nothing explains the difference in words.

questions.q: Entry, privacy, passage — which one is which?
What is the backset?
What is the cross bore diameter for the door prep?
Can it be master keyed with the rest of the building?
What door thickness does it take?
Is the chassis steel or zinc?
Is it ANSI Grade 1, 2 or 3?

needs.why: We hold no ANSI/BHMA certification (client confirmed). A buyer will still ask; the honest answer needs to exist somewhere rather than being silence.

questions.q: How many keys come with each lock?
Is the latch adjustable between 60 and 70mm?
Is it a tubular or a mortise lever set?
Is it solid stainless or zinc alloy with a coating?
How long is the lever?
What is the rose diameter?
Will the matt black finish wear off?

needs.why: No finish-durability or salt-spray statement. Matt black is the finish buyers most distrust.

questions.q: Does it come with the spindle and screws?
Is it suitable for a bathroom with a thumbturn?
Can I get the handle and the lock case as one order?

needs.why: No cross-category bundle or 'commonly ordered with' content.

questions.q: Does it work on a 40mm door?
Is it left or right handed?
Does it lock automatically when the door shuts?
Can I open it from inside without a key in an emergency?
What is the case size?
How many keys are supplied?
Will it fit a door that opens outwards?
Is the cylinder replaceable with a euro one?
What is the backset from the door edge?
Is the body brass or painted steel?
Does it come with the strike box for the frame?
Can it be keyed alike across a block of flats?
What lengths do you have — 70mm, 80mm?
Is it a euro profile or an oval?
Can you supply them keyed alike?
How many pins? Is it anti-drill or anti-bump?

needs.why: No security-feature spec on cylinders. This is the deciding question in the category.

questions.q: Is it double cylinder or thumbturn on one side?
Is the body brass?
Can I order a master key system for a whole project?
How many keys per cylinder?
Do the offsets come in 30/40, 35/45?
Do you have a European standard certification for these?

needs.why: No EN 1303 statement. Tenders in Europe and Latin America ask for it by number.

questions.q: What door weight and width will it handle?
Is the closing speed adjustable?
Does it have hold-open?
Is this a floor spring or an overhead closer?
What is the maximum opening angle?
Can it be used on a fire door?
Will it leak oil in a hot climate?

needs.why: No temperature-range statement. Buyers in Gulf and Latin American markets ask this specifically.

questions.q: Is it EN 1154 certified, and what power size?

needs.why: The EN 1154 report on file belongs to another company and was removed. We have no closer certification to state — say so rather than staying silent.

questions.q: Does it suit a glass door?
What is included — arm, cover, fixing plate?

needs.why: No box-contents statement for closers.

questions.q: Single or double cylinder?
How far does the bolt throw?
What backset?
What door thickness?
Is the bolt hardened against sawing?

needs.why: No security-feature detail. The whole point of a deadbolt.

questions.q: Can it be keyed alike with the knob lock on the same door?
Is the strike reinforced for the frame?
What finishes?
Does it fit a standard 54mm cross bore?
Only seven models — is that the whole range?

needs.why: Deadbolts is our thinnest category at 7 records. Either the range is thin or the catalogue is incomplete; a buyer cannot tell.

questions.q: What sizes do you have — 4 inch, 5 inch?
How thick is the leaf?
Ball bearing or plain?
Is it solid brass or brass plated steel?
How many hinges per door do I need?

needs.why: No selection guidance. An easy explainer that answer engines would quote.

questions.q: What door weight will three of these carry?

needs.why: No load rating on hinges.

questions.q: Are they fire rated?
Do the screws come with them?

needs.why: No box-contents statement.

questions.q: Are they sold in pairs or singly?

needs.why: Unit of sale is not stated anywhere and it changes the quoted price by 2x.

questions.q: Will stainless ones rust near the coast?

needs.why: No corrosion-grade statement (304 vs 201 vs 316), which is exactly what coastal buyers ask.

questions.q: What grade of stainless — 304 or 201?
What is the overall length and the fixing centres?
What tube diameter?
Will it fit a glass door, and what glass thickness?
Is it back to back or single sided?
Satin or mirror polish?
How far does it stand off the door?
Will it corrode in a swimming pool or coastal building?

needs.why: No corrosion-grade statement, and 35 records in this category are exactly where it matters.

questions.q: Do the fixings come with it?

needs.why: No box-contents statement.

questions.q: Can you make a custom length for our project?
What glass thickness do the patch fittings take — 10mm, 12mm?
Do I need a floor spring with these patch fittings?

needs.why: No cross-category compatibility content between patch fittings and floor springs, though we sell both.

questions.q: Is the fitting stainless or aluminium with a cover?
Top patch, bottom patch, corner — which do I need for one door?

needs.why: No assembly or set-composition guide. A frameless door needs a specific combination.

questions.q: What is the handle length for a glass door?
Does it come with the glass gaskets?

needs.why: No box-contents statement.

questions.q: Can it take a lock?
What finish options are there?
Is it suitable for a shopfront that gets heavy use?
Do you supply the whole set for one door as a package?

needs.why: Same set-composition gap; the buyer wants one line on a quote, not eight.

questions.q: Is it stainless or chrome plated brass?
What are the dimensions?
Is it wall mounted, and do fixings come with it?
Will the finish survive a humid bathroom?

needs.why: No corrosion or humidity statement on 45 records in a category defined by humidity.

questions.q: Can I buy a matching set — towel bar, hook, paper holder?

needs.why: No series or matching-set grouping, though the catalogue clearly contains families.

questions.q: Is it suitable for a hotel?
What finishes?
Is it concealed fixing or visible screws?
What projection from the wall?
Do you do grab rails rated for disabled access?

needs.why: Accessibility products are a distinct tender requirement and we say nothing about them.

questions.q: What are the fixing centres on the plate?
Does it include the lock, or just the handle set?

needs.why: No box-contents statement; this category is the one most often mis-ordered because of it.

questions.q: What door thickness?
Is it for an entrance door?
Is it handed?
What is the plate material and finish?
Can it take a euro cylinder?
What is the backset?
Can I get a matching interior lever on the other side?

needs.why: No matching-set content across grip sets and lever handles.

questions.q: Only eleven models — do you have more?

needs.why: Thin category (11 records); a buyer cannot tell if that is the range or the publishing gap.

questions.q: What viewing angle does the door viewer give?
What door thickness does the viewer suit?
How long is the flush bolt?
Is the door stopper floor or wall mounted?
Do you have a power transfer for an electric strike?
Is the indicator a vacant/engaged type for a toilet?
Are the house numbers stainless and how big?
Is the security guard chain or bar type?
This category has fifty different things in it — how do I find what I need?

needs.why: Fifty unlike products under one heading. Nine sub-categories exist as filters but the category page does not lead with them.

questions.q: Do you have magnetic catches and door seals too?

needs.why: Range boundaries are not stated; a buyer cannot tell what we do NOT make.

questions.q: Is this for a sliding door or a pocket door?
What backset?
Does the hook engage automatically?
Can it take a euro cylinder?
What door thickness?
Is the strike included for the jamb?
What is the case size?
Is it suitable for an aluminium sliding door?
Only three models — is that everything?

needs.why: Smallest category at 3 records. Either state that it is a niche line or expand it.

questions.q: Do you have the matching handle for a sliding door?

needs.why: No matching-set content.
